description: This file contains utility functions for handling ISO8601 date/time formats, including conversions between time representations, formatting current time, and parsing ISO8601 strings. It also includes functions for formatting system uptime.

methods.name: iso8601_cur_time
methods.description: Gets the current UTC time in ISO8601 string format.

methods.name: iso8601_from_unix_time
methods.description: Converts a time_t value to an ISO8601 string.

methods.name: iso8601_strftime
methods.description: Formats a struct tm into an ISO8601 string with optional timezone info.

methods.name: iso8601_us_strftime
methods.description: Formats a timeval into an ISO8601 string with microsecond precision.

methods.name: iso8601_to_unix_time
methods.description: Parses an ISO8601 string into a UTC-based unix time.

methods.name: uptime_strftime
methods.description: Formats system uptime in a human-readable string.
